definitions.total_imported_identifiers: Identifier occurrences across audited datasets, including repeated exact identifiers and generated mirrors; not a watch count.
definitions.distinct_individual_watch_identifiers: Eligible individual identifiers, not a claim that every watch or its specifications are authenticated.
definitions.models_with_specifications: Individual watch identifiers with at least one own technical catalog field; no shared-module case data is copied.
definitions.reference_only_models: Individual watch identifiers without their own technical catalog fields.
definitions.duplicate_exact_identifiers: Occurrences beyond the first exact identifier; different suffixes, punctuation and regions remain separate.
